support.heading: Support this work
support.note: CHAKRA is free and offline-first. Support is voluntary and buys nothing extra.

ads.note: Off by default. No slot renders and no request is made until enabled AND a client id is set AND consent is given.

ai.note: Providers are configuration. The visitor chooses; the key never leaves their browser; no vendor is named in any built page.
